entry.title: Chasing away the oxalates in kiwiberry

link.title: Chasing away the oxalates in kiwiberry

entry.content: Participation in 3-Minute Thesis Competition was my first attempt in science communication. This was an awakening experience for me with a realization of how hard it is to communicate your scientific research to a general audience. I am thankful to UNH Graduate School and organizers for this experience. One of my best memories of being at University of New Hampshire.
